lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Agent as you know the earth has entered a time of crisis where overpopulation and overconsumption of necessitates has ran our planet baren.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Lucky for you however one of our great scientist has hacked his way into an intergalactic satellite and has gotten us access to the interstellar dating app TINDERSTELLER

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: We have made you an account and your mission is to get in contact with aliens from the closest planets and find out which one is the most habitable

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: You must be careful on this mission because if you say the wrong thing they will figure out you are really human and the mission will be lost as well as earth

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Good luck on this mission Agent the fate of humankind rest in your hands
